name: The Grave Knight
summary: In Tarren Mill, Melisara sends you after Atrexis, who raises the dead beneath Dalaran. She sees his work as an affront to the Forsaken.

sections.title: Melisara's Charge
sections.body: Melisara calls Atrexis a traitor to the Forsaken. Beneath Dalaran, he raises an undead army. She asks you to defeat him, though she cares little for the mage city's fate. No one is beyond the Dark Lady's reach.

faq.answer: Atrexis is a necromancer in Dalaran, whom Melisara calls the Grave Knight.
Melisara in Tarren Mill asks you to defeat Atrexis.

faq.q: Why does Melisara want Atrexis defeated?
faq.answer: Melisara calls Atrexis a traitor to the Forsaken because he raises an undead army beneath Dalaran.
Atrexis is in the City of Dalaran.

angles.text: Melisara cares little for Dalaran's fate as she sends you after Atrexis.
As an undead, you know Melisara calls Atrexis a traitor to the Forsaken. She says his undead army defies what the Forsaken stand for.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Grave Knight
